title: Crafting new game loragame.cz
author: Adept-Ad4107
selftext: Hi everyone, who wants join to me on this journey of creating new MMORPG game, where players have posibilities as in other well known MMORPG games but many things surplus and have 2D text based style in combination with 3D arena fights. I want say that game engine is based on Three.js. I want make community of creative people! Anyone can join even if you're not a programmer, it doesn't matter AI together will allow us to overcome the impossible. So don't be lazy and join me!
